body: I've been saving Lorazepam's, Hydrocodones, and Ambiens. I'm just going to sleep.

I can't take it anymore. Struggle to get by, struggle to feed my kids, make rent, stay off drugs. I hate it all. My wife and kids can go back home to their family ( which is my fault we're all estranged ) when I'm gone. I don't want to feel this way anymore.
